common nominal configuration except free flag

timing_semantics: History elapsed is sampled when rec is created, before that iteration's relayout, complete-gradient evaluation, log and callback. Previous iterations' later work enters subsequent samples. Logs are rounded UTC seconds. Neither history nor final iteration log includes final batteries or total job lifetime. Hardware exclusivity is a producer scheduling statement, not established by these logs.
scope: Exact saved-history selection and log accounting. Objective is the producer self-consistent weighted O1, not an independently evaluated physical residual. Common time budgets select the last available recorded iterate without interpolation; sample times generally differ. No isolated causal measurement of FREE/FIXED runtime differences.
